newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury to sell $17 bln of bills Aug 11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury to sell $17 bln of bills Aug 11.

text.p: The Treasury Department announced on Tuesday that it will sell $17 bln of three- and six-month bills on Aug 11, resulting in about a $450 million paydown of oustanding debt as $17.441 bln of bills are maturing.
The bills, to be sold in equal amounts for each maturity, will be issued on Aug 14. The three-month bills mature on Nov 13 and the six-month bills mature on Feb 12, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills will be 9127942W3 and the six-month bills will be 9127946D1.
